experiment: E2 redshift-distance relation: effective H, q0, and the early/late H0 discrepancy in the model's terms

standard_theory.H0_late: 73.0 +/- 1.0 km/s/Mpc (SH0ES, Riess et al. 2022, ApJL 934, L7)

model_prediction_derived_from_documents.law: H(t) = (1/k) dk/dt; k ~ t^n gives q0 = -(n-1)/n; linear load n = 1 (q0 = 0), quadratic load n = 2 (q0 = -1/2); paper's fitted n = 1.4 gives q0 = -0.29
model_prediction_derived_from_documents.lattice_plan: closed rows L = 16..96 with (i) constant emission (k linear in age) and (ii) emission proportional to the emitter's own cycle count (k quadratic in age). Measure z(D) from the eye's counter; fit the FRW-correspondence family D = A[(1+z)^((n-1)/n) - 1] (n = 1: A ln(1+z)) with a launch-offset nuisance to extract n and q0 = -(n-1)/n with errors; read H_eff(t) = (1/k) dk/dt from the hop schedule and its sign of change with age.
model_prediction_derived_from_documents.expected: linear: n = 1.0 +/- 0.2, q0 = 0; quadratic: n = 2.0 +/- 0.3, q0 = -0.5; H_eff decreasing with age in both (H ~ n/t): late-time H smaller than early-time H
model_prediction_derived_from_documents.hubble_tension_reading: the model is a flat-FRW mimic, so it cannot by itself make a single H0 read differently early and late; the only lattice-derived effect is the q0 bias on a ladder analysed with LCDM's q0 = -0.55 when the true q0 is the model's; predicted bias at z = 0.02-0.15 is below 1 percent for q0 = -0.29 and about +1.5 percent at q0 = 0 (too small, sign: fitted local H0 higher than true). The model has no early-universe observable (no CMB, no BAO), so the early value has no counterpart.

observation_note: no absolute calibration on the lattice: only the sign and shape of H(t) and q0 are results

pass_fail.code_pass: 12 rays absorbed per run, quanta conserved, eye clock = ticks, field total grows linearly (i) or quadratically (ii) with age, zero-emission control z = 0
pass_fail.model_candidate_falsified_if: the fitted n for the quadratic load is not within 2 sigma of 2 or the linear load not within 2 sigma of 1 (the FRW correspondence claimed in the paper would then not hold on the lattice), or H_eff increases with age
pass_fail.verdict_rule: if the lattice gives q0 in {0, -0.5} for its own two histories and the tension needs a differential > 5 percent between epochs, the lattice is undecidable on the tension itself; record the bias magnitude and sign
